Orissa High Court Denies Bail in ASO Exam Paper Leak Case

The Orissa High Court has denied bail to 14 individuals accused in the ASO (Assistant Section Officer) exam paper leak case. The court expressed concern that such actions "shatter the confidence of hardworking youth." This decision underscores the judiciary's stance on exam malpractices and their impact on aspiring candidates.
